description: The update door: requirement, command and timeoutS change together with STRING/NUMBER values, and the changed command here is credential-shaped, so the daemon answers with its scrubbed-environment note (VerifyEnvNoteSentence, verify.go l.321) beside the gate — note is omitempty and appears ONLY when CommandIsTokenShaped matches; this fixture is that sample. The note is the daemon's sentence to print verbatim, never a refusal: the person decides whether the token was meant to be there.

result.note: gate commands run with a scrubbed environment; do not embed a credential
